title: The blanket, washed
logline: The blanket — the frame shop's backroom blanket from 2000 — on the line in February, washed, worn to the weave in one corner. Twenty-five years of dogs. The page draws the thin corner.

panels.composition: A wool blanket pinned on a clothesline in February wind, worn thin to the weave at one corner, the garage door beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a wool blanket pinned on a clothesline in February wind worn thin to the weave at one corner, a garage door beyond, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
